landing.freeTagline: 100% free â€” no paywalls, no ads. Open source under AGPL-3.0.
landing.heroSubtitle: Forget the spreadsheets. Forget the 90-minute waits. Pick a club, pick a tactic, hit play â€” and feel the game move at arcade speed.
landing.dominanceSubtitle: Watch the simulation unfold. Hyper-speed highlights and instant tactical adjustments redefined.
landing.tacticalDescription: Switch tactics on the fly. See your team change instantly. Every match plays out different â€” and it's over before you'd usually finish the warmup.
landing.featureManageDesc: Take the reins of any club and lead them to glory through tactical masterclasses and strategic growth.
landing.featureManageDescription: Counter, press, possession, direct, balanced. Pick a style, watch it click. Change it at half time if it isn't working.
landing.featureScoutDesc: Unearth future stars and watch them evolve through intensive training and crucial match experience.
landing.featureScoutDescription: Find young talent before anyone else does. Sign them, play them, watch them grow into legends.
landing.featureFinanceDesc: Balance the books, navigate the transfer market, and build a sustainable footballing empire.
landing.featureFinanceDescription: Take an underdog to the top, or defend a giant from the climb. Every club has a story â€” write yours.
landing.featureArcadeDesc: Experience fast-paced match results with high-octane visual highlights that skip the boredom.
landing.featureArcadeDescription: A full match runs in minutes, not hours. Skip the boring stuff. Stay for the goals.
landing.faqBaseSub: Everything you need to know before the kick-off.
landing.faqA1: It's a football management arcade. No spreadsheets, no 90-minute waits â€” just fast matches, snappy decisions, and the fun parts of running a club.
landing.faqQ2: How long does a match take?
landing.faqA2: Around seven minutes from kickoff to full time. You'll finish a season before others finish pre-season.
landing.faqQ3: Do I have to micro-manage everything?
landing.faqA3: No. Pick a tactic, pick your XI, hit play. Tweak when it matters â€” we don't waste your time.
landing.faqA4: Pick a giant, pick an underdog, or rebuild a fallen club. Across Europe and South America â€” your story, your way.
landing.faqA5: Play them well, train them right, and they level up. Veterans peak, then fade. No hidden numbers â€” what you see is what you get.
landing.faqA6: Not yet. Solo career is the focus. We'll bring players together once the single-player loop is at its best.
landing.joinArcadeRevolution: Pick a club. Pick a tactic. Write your story. Free, in your browser.
landing.readySubtitle: Join the arcade revolution today and define the future of digital football management.

england.name: Inglaterra
england.headline:
In England, football is tradition.
Built on structure, discipline, and respect for the game.
Every pass has purpose, every role is defined.
From muddy pitches to grand stadiums, the spirit endures.
the game belongs to those who honor its roots.

france.name: Francia
france.headline:
In France, football is balance.
Technique meets physical power, flair meets control.
Players are shaped with precision and intelligence.
Strength and elegance move as one.
the game belongs to those who master both body and mind.

germany.name: Alemania
germany.headline:
In Germany, football is efficiency.
Every action is calculated, every movement optimized.
Discipline drives the team forward, together as one.
No wasted effort, no lost focus.
the game belongs to those who execute without error.

italy.name: Italia
italy.headline:
In Italy, football is strategy.
The game is read, studied, and controlled.
Defense is an art, patience is a weapon.
Moments are chosen, not forced.
the game belongs to those who think before they act.

spain.name: España
spain.headline:
In Spain, football is rhythm.
The ball moves, the team flows, space is created.
Short passes, constant motion, quiet control.
The game is dictated, not chased.
the game belongs to those who never let it stop.

brazil.name: Brasil
brazil.headline:
In Brazil, football is not learnedâ€”it is felt.
It lives in the streets, in the noise, in the rhythm of everyday life.
From simple beginnings came a style built on creativity and freedom.
Not just to winâ€”but to play beautifully.
the game belongs to those who dare to play it with joy.
